nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Pure pact-log projector that folds a chronological event stream into a State view (project, agents, features, tasks, awaiting_count); exported interface definitions for Seat/Task/Feature/State/PactEvent and the single `project` reducer.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements an event-fold reducer with internal index maps (fIdx, tIdx) for O(1) task lookup; nested `find` closure inside `project` mirrors a typical event-sourcing projection pattern.

nodes.name: project
nodes.summary: Reducer that scans events backwards for the latest init (priming project name + seats), then folds init/add-seat/assign/join/start/checkpoint/accept/changes_requested/merge/cancel/withdraw events into State; cancels tasks and withdraws features post-fold and recomputes awaiting_count.

nodes.name: seatFromPayload
nodes.summary: Builds a Seat from an event payload by coercing id/roles/kind strings through the local str/payloadStr/payloadArr helpers and pushing non-empty roles onto the seat's roles array.

nodes.name: parity.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest parity suite that replays a golden JSONL event vector through `project` and asserts deep-equal output against the golden state JSON plus a manual awaiting_count recomputation.

nodes.name: unit.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest unit suite covering 20+ behavioral cases of `project`: empty events, init priming, idempotent add-seat, assign/deps/start/checkpoint/accept/changes_requested/merge, cancel/withdraw retirement, join-driven task lifting with dep readiness, multi-feature ordering, and unknown event-type tolerance.

nodes.name: ev
nodes.summary: Test helper that mints a PactEvent with auto-incremented ev<NNN> id, fixed ts/agent_id/role, empty task/feature/payload defaults, and caller-supplied overrides; backed by the module-level nextId counter.
